title: Deep learning-based grading of ductal carcinoma in situ in breast histopathology images
summary: A deep-learning system grades DCIS on whole-slide images against expert pathology assessments. An independent test set of 1,001 lesions from 50 patients is compared with three observers; the source notes same-center data and inter-observer disagreement.
